name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A few words that appear beside a control on hover or keyboard focus.

meta.when: Naming an icon-only button or adding a short hint. It does not open on touch, so never put anything needed there: the control keeps its own `aria-label`. For content people interact with use popover. Put one TooltipProvider around the app (root layout); every Tooltip must be inside one.
meta.example:
<TooltipProvider>
  <Tooltip>
    <TooltipTrigger asChild>
      <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Copy link"><Link2 /></Button>
    </TooltipTrigger>
    <TooltipContent>Copy link</TooltipContent>
  </Tooltip>
</TooltipProvider>
